brief.what: Approval Workflows: release approvals with named approvers, required checks and an audit trail, built into the Launch Service release calendar.
brief.who: Release managers and engineering leads at 50–500-person SaaS companies who approve releases today in Slack threads and spreadsheets.
brief.whyNow: Two of the top five churn reasons in Q3 exit interviews were 'no audit trail for releases'. SOC 2 renewals at our mid-market accounts land in Q1.
claims: Approve a release in one click from the release calendar or email
Every approval is logged with who, when and which checks passed
Included in the Business plan at no extra cost
Median approval time drops below 4 hours in beta workspaces

context.text: Launch Service schedules and ships releases for ~2,400 workspaces. Approvals happen outside the product, so the release calendar shows 'scheduled' while the real decision sits in Slack. Beta: 38 workspaces since July.
points: Releases are scheduled in Launch Service, but approval decisions happen in Slack and spreadsheets.
The calendar shows 'scheduled' while the real go/no-go sits elsewhere — no single source of truth.
38 beta workspaces have used Approval Workflows since July; 31 still use it weekly.

environment.text: Compliance pressure is rising: SOC 2 and ISO 27001 auditors now ask for release approval evidence. Budgets are flat, so buyers favour features inside the plan they already pay for over new tools.
points: SOC 2 and ISO 27001 auditors now request release-approval evidence.
Most mid-market SOC 2 renewals land in Q1 — the launch must ship before them.
Flat budgets favour features inside the current plan over new tools.

competitors.text: Two release-management competitors ship approvals as a paid add-on; CI platforms offer manual gates without an audit view for non-engineers. Our angle: approvals where release managers already plan, included in Business.

assets.title: Release notes
assets.content: New: Approval Workflows. Add named approvers and required checks to any release in the calendar. Approvers get a one-click approve link in the app and by email, and every decision is recorded in the release's audit trail with who approved, when, and which checks passed. Available on the Business plan.

assets.title: Blog post: Approvals belong where releases are planned
assets.content: Most release approvals still happen in a Slack thread that nobody can find during an audit. Approval Workflows moves that decision into the Launch Service release calendar: pick approvers, require the checks that matter, and approve in one click. In beta, median approval time fell below four hours, and every approval left an audit trail behind. Approval Workflows is included in the Business plan.

assets.title: Announcement email
assets.content:
Subject: Approve releases in one click — with a trail auditors love

Hi {first_name}, releases in your calendar can now require approval from named people, with the checks you choose. Approvers get a one-click link, and every decision is logged automatically. It's part of your Business plan today — open any release to add your first workflow.

assets.title: LinkedIn post
assets.content: Your release was approved. Where's the proof? Approval Workflows in Launch Service puts approvers, required checks and a full audit trail right on the release calendar. One click to approve. Zero screenshots of Slack for your auditor. Included in Business.

assets.title: Sales one-pager
assets.content: Approval Workflows — the audit-ready way to ship. Named approvers, required checks, one-click approval, full audit trail. Cuts approval time by 70%. Makes your release process SOC 2 compliant. Available as a $15/seat add-on for Team and Business plans.

assets.title: FAQ
assets.content:
Which plans include Approval Workflows? Business, at no extra cost.
Can an approver approve from email? Yes, with a one-click link that expires after 72 hours.
What does the audit trail record? Who approved, when, and which required checks had passed at that moment.
Can I export the audit trail? Yes, as CSV from the release history.
